name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd
title: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd - 512455 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Iron ore volume doubled to 22Mt with pellet plant at 100% utilisation and FY27 guided to 26Mt ore, 7.75-8Mt pellets; capex still rising to ~INR15,000 crore consolidated, with 49% Chemaf debt consolidated.

utilisation.quote: reached 100% capacity utilization within just 4 months

capex.quote: next year, it should be INR12,500 crores plus

evasions.topic: Consolidated receivables jump from INR171 crore to INR1,480 crore
evasions.quote: We don't have a clear cut answer on why exactly that movement is there.
I don't think we are ready with that exact figure that you're looking for.
I think the figures are all with you. We leave it to the analysts to analyze and confirm the figures.

triggers.label: Standalone capex ~INR13,500 crore FY24-26
triggers.quote: the company has incurred capex of approximately INR13,500 crores during FY24 to FY26

triggers.label: Pellet plant at 100% utilisation in 4 months
triggers.quote: reached 100% capacity utilization within just 4 months

triggers.label: Pellet realisation down sequentially
triggers.quote: the pellet realizations are a little lower because the newer markets are at a distance

triggers.label: Chemaf debt ~USD800m, ~USD330m stays
triggers.quote: the total debt which is there on the books of Chemaf is around USD800 million

triggers.label: FY27 iron ore 26Mt, pellet 7.75-8Mt
triggers.quote: iron ore production at 26 million tons, dispatches of 27 million tons, pellet of 7.75 million to 8 million tons

guidance.quote: iron ore production at 26 million tons, dispatches of 27 million tons
pellet of 7.75 million to 8 million tons
wire rod mill production at around 150,000 tons
We expect annual cost savings to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum
Console number 15000 crores for capex in this 26-27
we are looking at producing a total of around 9,000 to 10,000 tons of copper

red_flags.label: Consolidated receivables up ~8x with no explanation
red_flags.quote: We don't have a clear cut answer on why exactly that movement is there.

red_flags.label: Chemaf USD800m debt consolidated, USD200m more non-recourse borrowing
red_flags.quote: possibly we'll borrow additional $200 million, which will also be nonrecourse to LMEL

red_flags.label: Capex ramp with copper ramp dependent on July 2027 commissioning
red_flags.quote: Chemaf will not produce anything this year.
